page.layout: One page of text: running head at top with page number at left; a large-capital passage in full width at the top; "FINIS." centred below; a printed ornament (vignette) in the centre; catchword at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: STRUM DE iis, QUI HABITANT IN TERRA. Et qui talia testatus est, dixit: ETIAM, VENIO CITO. AMEN. suspirantibus omnibus, qui adventum ejus diligunt: ETIAM VENI, DOMINE JESU. Tibi Patri, Filio & Spiritui S. ob abyssos judiciorum & gratiarum divitiarumque Tuarum, sit Magnificentia & Robur, Gloria, & Victoria, & Honor in Secula Seculorum!

page.notes: The ornament below FINIS is a woodcut vignette with no text. Faint show-through of the reverse page (lines of text in the middle and lower part of the page) is not transcribed. The top heading block begins mid-word ("STRUM"), a fragment carried over from the previous page, and is kept as printed.
